decisions.reason: As a close-to-core design variant with likely low continuation cost and still-limited market feedback after launch, it is worth keeping the option open while demand becomes clearer.
This shower channel extends the firm's established drainage system logic, and with uncertainty about adoption still resolving in 2024, retaining it preserves upside at modest risk.

Although more specialized, the pump-assisted solution builds on the firm's drainage know-how and serves a potentially valuable niche, so real-options logic favors continued market presence until its value is better revealed.
The tileable floor drain fits the firm's core offer and current architectural trends, and there is no strong evidence yet that would justify abandoning the option so soon after launch.
As a close-to-core stainless steel design grate with likely limited holding cost and possible cross-selling benefits, it should remain on the market while its commercial potential is tested further.
